caveats: Does not host full text; only identifies open locations.

sources.name: US Census Bureau API

access.limits_summary: Works without a key for small volumes; a free key raises the daily query limit.

caveats: American Community Survey estimates carry margins of error that should travel with the ranking.

sources.name: USDA FoodData Central API

access.limits_summary: DEMO_KEY is heavily limited; a free api.data.gov key gets a higher quota.

caveats: US-focused food composition data.

access.limits_summary: See API docs; be reasonable.

sources.name: V-Dem Dataset

access.limits_summary: Not documented in this catalogue; check the provider's terms before bulk use.

license.name: CC BY-SA 4.0 (V-Dem dataset, verify current version)

caveats: Expert-coded indices carry measurement uncertainty; cite the version.

sources.name: WHO Global Health Observatory

access.limits_summary: See OData API documentation.

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO (WHO GHO, verify dataset)

caveats: Non-commercial restriction is significant for a commercial platform. Seek written permission or use World Bank/OWID alternatives.

sources.name: Wikidata Query Service

access.limits_summary: SPARQL endpoint has a query timeout and throttling policy; API is rate-limited. See docs.

caveats: Coverage is uneven. A Wikidata-derived ranking measures recorded structured knowledge, not real-world importance.

sources.name: Wikipedia / Wikimedia REST API

access.limits_summary: See Wikimedia API etiquette and pageview API guidance. Automated access must use a descriptive User-Agent.

license.name: CC BY-SA 4.0 (text); individual media licences vary
license.redistribution: Allowed with attribution and share-alike for derivative text.

caveats: Pageviews are an attention proxy, not a quality or sales measure.
Article text and images have different licences.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data API

access.limits_summary: No key required; API is rate-limited and should not be hammered.

caveats: Some indicators are sourced from third parties with separate terms.
Country aggregates are included; filter them out for country rankings.

sources.name: World Values Survey

access.limits_summary: Registration required for data download; terms apply.

caveats: Commercial use and redistribution require checking the current WVSA terms.
